ITEM 1 | Off-white, opaque, soft crumbly pieces with irregular rounded chunks roughly 1-2 cm, some flecked with small dark specks (possibly pepper), matte surface with little sheen, moist-looking but holding shape in a heaped mound covering roughly 35% of the plate's right and center area, about 1.5-2 cm tall, sitting directly on the plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Reddish-brown, curled strip with a smooth outer surface and a slightly ridged, scalloped edge, about 9-10 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide, firm and dry-looking with matte sheen, lying across the top edge of the white mound and against the plate | 20
